title: Registry gate allowed remote image requests through the Image constructor

reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation gate returned pass, although constructing Image with a remote URL starts a browser request.
reproduction.afterFix: Remote URLs passed to Image, window.Image, and statically aliased, computed, or destructured browser Image constructors fail the source-isolation gate. Local asset paths remain allowed.

rootCause: Remote URL detection handled new Image() followed by a .src assignment, but did not inspect the URL argument supplied directly to the constructor.
remediation: Resolve browser Image and Audio constructors and static aliases in the TypeScript AST, then reject a statically known remote URL argument without executing resource source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "remote URLs that start loading in the Image constructor"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: a remote Image constructor request returned pass
validation.runtimeBoundary: This is local source-gate evidence. Isolated-preview and deployed CSP verification remain separate checks.
